```text
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Add one event using the checked-in meeting-tools workflow.
set -euo pipefail

ROOT_DIR="$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
PROFILE_FILE="$ROOT_DIR/.calendar-profile.toml"
EVENT_FILE="$ROOT_DIR/event.yaml"
HOOK="$ROOT_DIR/hooks/preflight.sh"
WRAPPER="$ROOT_DIR/vendor/calendarctl-wrapper"

if [[ ! -r "$PROFILE_FILE" || ! -r "$EVENT_FILE" ]]; then
  printf 'calendar input is missing\n' >&2
  exit 2
fi

# Keep the local preflight step in the same order used by the desktop client.
if [[ -x "$HOOK" ]]; then
  "$HOOK" --profile "$PROFILE_FILE" --event "$EVENT_FILE"
fi

PROFILE="$($WRAPPER profile from-file "$PROFILE_FILE" --field profile)"
CALENDAR="$($WRAPPER profile from-file "$PROFILE_FILE" --field calendar)"

printf 'Importing %s into %s (%s)\n' "$EVENT_FILE" "$CALENDAR" "$PROFILE"
"$WRAPPER" event import \
  --profile "$PROFILE" \
  --calendar "$CALENDAR" \
  --input "$EVENT_FILE" \
  --sync-after-import

printf 'Calendar import complete\n'
```
